_comment: sim/input-offset closed-loop cross-check as a `klt sim` request (issue #504): the harness's SECOND method beside the null sweep.

Circuit: tb_offset_cl.body.spice -- the same test circuit as ../testbench/tb_offset_cl.spice.tmpl, run_offset_sweep.sh's pass 3: Lbreak = 1e18 H closes the unity-gain buffer at DC (inn = out) while inp sits at Vcm; one `op` analysis; the committed record's vout_cl_v column is this method.

A sibling request, not a second analysis of offset.request.json: `klt sim` runs one analysis per corner and the two methods need different topologies (the null sweep drives inn from a differential B-source; this bench ties inn to out through Lbreak).
Grid: cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt/ss/ff/sf/fs [DR-1] x {-40, 27, 125} C x VDD {1.08, 1.20, 1.32} V = 45 corners; vinp (the inp drive) sweeps WITH vdd by index, so Vcm = VDD/2 as in the harness.
Each MOS corner uses the fixed cap_typ and res_typ sections (DR-0012).

vout_cl_v carries no limit: it is the raw closed-loop output. The derived quantity vos_cl = -(vout_cl - Vcm)*(1 + Av0)/Av0 and its agreement with the null (xcheck_pass, tolerance max(200 uV, 5% |Vos|)) are computed offline from this envelope joined with the selected same-DUT sim/open-loop-ac/ record's per-corner Av0 -- see offset_post.py and compare.py. Av0 is NOT measured here.
options.timeout_s = 300 s per corner: one DC operating point of this circuit takes seconds.
Solver tolerance: ngspice default, no .options reltol/abstol/vntol (DR-0005).
ngspice_init raises the print precision so the envelope values are not rounded to 6 digits.
